name: Rocket Fuel - (1g) Live Resin - Permanent Marker
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, straight from the jar. Rocket Fuel Permanent Marker live resin delivers 1 gram of full-spectrum concentrate, extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with — bold, flavorful, and made for dabbing.

Permanent Marker is an award-winning hybrid born from crossing Biscotti, Jealousy, and Sherb Bx1 — and its aroma is every bit as loud as the name suggests. Expect a pungent, complex profile: sharp chemical funk and gas up front, layered with soapy floral notes, cool mint, and a sweet, creamy finish. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect — a potent, balanced calm that settles the body while keeping a happy, easygoing lift.

Why you'll love it:

1G live resin — fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature Permanent Marker flavor — pungent gas and funk with soapy floral, mint, and cream
Jar packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Rocket Fuel Permanent Marker is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
